subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Scanty
solution:
The correct answer is **Abundant.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Let's have a look at the given antonyms:

__
 
• ***Scanty*** means small or insufficient in amount.

 
 
• ***Eg.*** he has provided us with* scanty* information.
 
 
 
• *Abundant* means plenty of.
 
 
• ***Eg. ***he has* abundant* supply of food.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let's look at the meaning of the other given words:

 
• **Expedient -** convenient and practical although possibly improper or immoral

 
 
• ***Eg.** *It might be *expedient* not to pay him until the work is finished.
 
 
 
• **Paltry -** very small or meagre
 
 
• ***Eg. ***student grants these days are** ***paltry.*
 
 
 
• **Nasty - **behaving in an unpleasant way** **
 
 
• ***Eg.* **harry was a *nasty* boy.
